caption:
Mortgage rates are still way above last year. 🏠
Freddie Mac's 30-year average was 7.11% in its Nov. 12 survey. A year earlier it was 6.24%.
On a $300,000 loan, that's roughly $2,020 a month in principal and interest vs about $1,845. About $175 more, every month.
Is buying a home still on your list, or on pause?
